build_custom_llm_completion: build a custom LLM completion handler that sends messages to an API base and returns a ModelResponse
build_custom_llm_streaming: build a custom LLM streaming handler that returns an iterator of GenericStreamingChunks from an API base
build_custom_llm_acompletion: build an async custom LLM completion handler that sends messages to an API base and returns a ModelResponse
build_custom_llm_astreaming: build an async custom LLM streaming handler that returns an async iterator of GenericStreamingChunks from an API base
build_custom_chat_llm_router: build a custom chat LLM router that dispatches to completion, acompletion, streaming, or astreaming based on async and stream flags
